name: Collaborative Code Editor
summary: Collaborative code editor CodeComponent powered by CodeMirror with basicSetup. Features a language mode Select for JavaScript, Python, HTML, and CSS with live syntax highlighting. Save button triggers useHandler('saveSnippet') with toast confirmation. Author info from useCurrentUser displayed in the status bar. Real-time cursor position (line/column) and character count shown in the footer. Kbd component shows the Ctrl+S save shortcut. useAppState persists editor content and selected language. Uses CodeMirror.EditorView, CodeMirror.basicSetup, Select, Card, Button, Badge, Kbd, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: CodeMirror editor with language selection, save handler, cursor position tracking, and keyboard shortcut
